outcomes.outcome: rsyslog and its GnuTLS driver are installed, and rsyslog runs and starts at boot
the node's Puppet CA, certificate and key are copied for rsyslog, byte for byte, and form a valid identity (from the ssldir_override given)
with no ssldir_override, the copies come from the default ssldir /var/lib/puppet/ssl

uncovered.why: no lab run can leave ssldir_override unset, and no lab agent keeps its ssldir at /var/lib/puppet/ssl (the pre-AIO packages' path); production uses the arm unless its Hiera sets the key: of the 36 production node statements that set rsyslog_client's target, 1 sets ssldir_override, and 1 node statement sets it on rsyslog_base (names only; Hiera not read). On an OpenVox agent the copies would have no source: documentation list, cutover row 10
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: a Hiera variant per run, and an agent whose ssldir is /var/lib/puppet/ssl
uncovered.evidence: master_fixtures.sh binds puppet_infrastructure::rsyslog_base::ssldir_override to /etc/puppetlabs/puppet/ssl in the lab Hiera for every run, and phase3.py variant_problems (2026-11-23) lets a variant vary only its node and params; on the node, ls /var/lib/puppet/ssl gives "No such file or directory" (the reviewer, 20261123T174701Z); diagnosis/fleet_variant_usage.md (2026-11-23) for the counts

outcomes.outcome: the user rsyslog drops to (syslog) can read the key, and other users cannot
a stopped rsyslog runs again after the next agent run
a change to the TLS directory restarts rsyslog at the next agent run
a change to a TLS file (a renewed certificate) restarts rsyslog once at the next agent run
on RedHat, a syslog user and group (uid/gid 0) exist for the copied files' ownership
